Personally I like RPGs. There's nothing like swapping gear and learning new skills together that really brings a group together. Everyone finds their own niche and a way to work together to bring down the boss.

And with RPGs I find it doesn't matter so much how good the players are compared to each other. I like playing with people who are almost, but not quite as good at the game as I am, otherwise it's less fun. With RPGs it's less important who has faster reflexes and whether both players are experienced with the game. Plus, I tend to drink all my friend's beer, and I seem to get better at RPGs when buzzed.

That's a good perspective. I think RPGs are more about story and shooters are more about gameplay. RPGs are a great way to enjoy a story together when you've got the time. With Borderlands I'm always stuck with "I've got a level 20, a 5, and a 15, what do you got?" damn, 30. Oh well :P
